name: betoch-monorepo
description: Betoch — High-Performance Home Rental Marketplace for Ethiopia and Emerging Markets

scripts.build: npm run build -w @betoch/shared && npm run build -w @betoch/validation && npm run build -w @betoch/config && npm run build -w @betoch/api && npm run build -w @betoch/web
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/commission.test.ts tests/telebirr.test.ts tests/validation.test.ts tests/ai.test.ts tests/identity.test.ts
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @betoch/api && npm run lint -w @betoch/web
